$comment: p15-oracle-076: tuning of the workspace, home and space action families for gen_actions.py (p15-oracle-071), which reads it as <family>/_tuning.json (oracle.py skips _ files) and keeps regeneration byte-stable. 98 ids of plans/cmux-next/action-surfaces.json belong to the three families (the design's 92 plus ids added since); 87 entries here, each reviewed against its handler. Not tuned: the 6 gaps every-action-gaps.json lists (home.channels; space.newWindow, space.newWorkspace, space.switch, workspace.duplicateToSpace, workspace.moveToSpace need a space argument: p15-oracle-086) and the 5 destructive ids the sweep never runs (home.leaveConversation, workspace.closeAll, workspace.closeAllInAllWindows, workspace.closeOthersInGroup, workspace.stash). A run through action.run is a socket caller without focus: only the focus actions (ActionCatalog.focusActionIDs: workspace.select*, space.next/previous/selectByNumber/switch, home.show/switchView/openConversation/previous/nextConversation) change the view, every other run files what it makes without showing it or is refused with RefusalStrings.homeNeedsFocus, as Chrome's extension API creates a tab with active false. Refusals are control.unavailable (ControlError.actionOutcome: refused, and the tracked work's ActionWorkFailure). Legacy bind handlers report action.done; workspace.toggleArchive is a bindEffect handler that returns .done.
